Spire Healthcare is committed to making the information and features on its website accessible to as many people as possible.
We cannot make everything on the site accessible but you should be able to:
change colours, contrast levels and fonts
end of listitem, level 1, position 1, set size 5
zoom in up to 300% without the text spilling off the screen
end of listitem, level 1, position 2, set size 5
navigate most of the website using just a keyboard
end of listitem, level 1, position 3, set size 5
navigate most of the website using speech recognition software
end of listitem, level 1, position 4, set size 5
listen to most of the website using a screen reader (including the most recent versions of JAWS, NVDA and VoiceOver)
end of listitem, level 1, position 5, set size 5
The website site has been built using W3C standards compliant code for HTML and CSS. This means that the site displays correctly in current browsers and will display correctly in future browsers.
The website is partially compliant with the
Level AA standard. We are continually working to develop the site in a way that meets accessibility and usability guidelines and best practice.
